Before using this tool, make sure you have loaded the uipath-rpa skill and read its documentation. uipath-rpa/SKILL.md is the canonical reference. Direct CLI use without loading the skill bypasses authoring rules that catch errors early.

                          uip rpa uia snapshot capture                          
List top-level targets (windows and browser tabs), or drill into one to extract its element tree.
                Use --help with nested commands for more detail.                

┌─ Usage ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ uip rpa uia snapshot capture [w/b-ref] [--project-dir <string>] [--remote] [--visualize] [--type { Default | CV }] [--framework { Default | UIA | AA | Java }] [--all-windows] [--folder-path <string>] │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ w/b-ref   Window or browser tab target reference (e.g: w1 or b3)             │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

┌─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ --project-dir <string>         The project directory.                        │
│ --remote                       Execute the command on the remote machine.    │
│ --visualize                    Briefly highlight the target element during   │
│                                the operation (for visual confirmation).      │
│ --type <Default|CV>            What to capture. Default captures the         │
│                                programmatic elements of the application. CV  │
│                                runs computer-vision analysis and captures    │
│                                only the elements visible in the view.        │
│                                [default: Default]                            │
│ --framework                    UI scanning framework. Default is recommended │
│ <Default|UIA|AA|Java>          for most apps, especially browsers.           │
│ --all-windows                  Show all top-level windows in the rendered    │
│                                tree, disabling the default filtering         │
│ --folder-path <string>         The folder to write the snapshot artifacts    │
│                                to. When omitted, a timestamped folder is     │
│                                created under the project's                   │
│                                .local/.uia/.interact/output folder.          │
│ --studio-dir <path>            Path to Studio installation directory         │
│ --robot-dir <path>             Path to Robot installation directory          │
│ --timeout <seconds>            Timeout in seconds                            │
│ --verbose                      Enable verbose logging                        │
│ --policy-file <path>           Governance policy to judge this invocation by │
│                                where the signed-in tenant has none           │
│ --policy-file-type <type>      Format of --policy-file                       │
│ -h, --help                     display help for command                      │
│ --output                       Output format (default: json)                 │
│ <table|json|yaml|plain|markd                                                 │
│ own>                                                                         │
│ --output-filter <expression>   JMESPath expression applied to the Data field │
│                                of the response envelope                      │
│ --log-level                    Log level threshold (default: info)           │
│ <debug|info|warn|error>                                                      │
│ --log-file <path>              Write logs to file instead of stderr          │
│ --profile <name>               Use a named login profile                     │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
